name: ghosted
description: Makes Claude Code cheaper: when you start a new task it saves the old chat and starts you fresh (or summarises it when the new task builds on the old one), keeps answers short and keeps the cache warm during breaks.

keep_warm.title: Keep the cache warm for
keep_warm.description: After your last message, keep Claude's prompt cache warm this long (for example 1h or 90m; off to disable), so coming back from a break doesn't cost extra. Press Enter for the default.
